description: Align Workflow retry targeting and recovery-continuation authority so status, control, and runner behavior share one rule each.

tasks.title: Unify failed-work retry targeting
tasks.description: Refactor WorkflowRun retry-target resolution so retry execution and available-actions mapping consume the same task-or-check target. Include legacy ContextExhaustion task failures while retaining existing retry, rerun, and rerun-from-stage behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: A single WorkflowRun retry-target resolver identifies retryable task and check work for both control execution and status presentation.
A persisted ContextExhaustion failure with an identifiable failed task exposes retry and creates a new attempt of that task.
Check retry continues to rerun the identified check, and failures without a target expose no retry and leave the run unchanged when retry is attempted.
Focused Server unit and spec coverage verifies ordinary task, check, legacy ContextExhaustion, no-target, retry, rerun, and rerun-from-stage behavior; the relevant Server test projects pass.
tasks.output: WorkflowRun retry-target resolver and status/control integration with regression coverage.
tasks.notes: Do not add a second status-only retryability branch or change the existing workflow control API.

tasks.title: Make runner the recovery-budget authority
tasks.description: Narrow Server recovery follow-up validation to declaration and continuation-state shape, allowing numeric values outside the declared budget to persist and dispatch unchanged. Retain the existing Runner clamp as the only declared-budget interpretation.
acceptanceCriteria: Server accepts and preserves negative and above-budget numeric recoveryRemaining values on otherwise valid recovery follow-ups.
Server still rejects a recovery follow-up without explicit numeric continuation state and a non-recovery follow-up that supplies continuation state.
Runner recovery evaluation clamps a negative allowance to zero and an above-budget allowance to the declared budget before automatic recovery selection.
Focused Server workflow recovery and Runner recovery tests cover accepted out-of-range transport, malformed shape rejection, and both clamp outcomes; the relevant Server and Runner test suites pass.
tasks.output: Structural Server follow-up validation and verified Runner-owned recovery allowance bounds.
tasks.notes: No persistence migration, protocol change, or change to recovery handler, retrySelf, or manual-retry semantics.
